'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 T.J. Holman DS Twi'lek Advisor (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[T.J. Holman]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Twi'lek Advisor (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-45-Twi_lek_Advisor-remaster.webp|label=Twi'lek Advisor (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
